title: test(rest): give the view CONTROL read the budget its cold lint load needs
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DU5CHkeh2msc49m4dh6kwEt)_

## Summary

Test-only. `packages/rest/src/meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts` › "CONTROL — a type ADR-0150 does not address by package (view) is served as before" timed out (`Test timed out in 5000ms`) in two merge-queue builds for #33322 (runs 43633136778: 5089ms, 43637152754: 5281ms). It passed in a third queue build on the same code (43633195065: 2816ms).

## Why

It is the file's only served `view` read. `metadata-diagnostics.ts` attaches `@objectstack/lint` warnings to view reads and loads the lint bundle lazily, so the first view read in a vitest worker pays the cold load: measured on `main` b4624440, 716–853ms for the first drive and 1–2ms for an identical second drive; loading the bundle alone took 1027ms. On a loaded runner that load passes 5s. Nothing hangs. It only shows when the queue runs `rest` uncached (e.g. a PR that changes `turbo.json`).

## What changes

- The one test gets a 30s budget, with a comment naming the cold load it pays for. Assertions unchanged.

Local: origin/main 4 runs and main + #33322 2 runs, 302/302 each.

No changeset (test-only).
